instruction: Find names that are related to Benjamin

metadata.explanation: Task variation to find related names to Benjamin. Evaluator uses URL pattern matching to verify the user navigated to Benjamin's name details page on babycenter.com.
metadata.verification_notes: Leverages is_expected_url_pattern_match for reliable URL verification without needing exact name IDs.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL SEMANTIC MISMATCH: Instruction asks to 'Find names that are related to Benjamin' but evaluator only verifies navigation to Benjamin's own name details page (not pages showing related names)
The instruction implies finding OTHER names similar/related to Benjamin, but the URL pattern 'benjamin-' matches Benjamin's own page, not a related names list
The evaluator cannot verify the actual task requirement (finding related names) - it only verifies visiting Benjamin's page
Getter and metric functions work correctly (can extract URL and pattern match), but they verify the wrong semantic requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Change instruction to match evaluator - 'Navigate to Benjamin's name details page on babycenter.com'
Option 2: Change evaluator to match instruction - verify URL contains '/related-names' or check page content for related name suggestions using HTML parsing
Option 3: If babycenter.com shows related names on Benjamin's details page, add content verification to check for presence of related name elements in the page HTML
